_description: Complete recipe for water effects. Covers splash, rain, waterfall, ripple, and underwater variants.

base_architecture.design_philosophy: Water is transparent, refractive, and gravity-driven. Key traits: arc trajectories, surface tension (droplets), foam/mist at high energy areas, ripples on surface.

splash.description: Object or character hitting water surface

emitter_layers.name: Crown_Splash
emitter_layers.purpose: Ring of water rising then falling around impact point
emitter_layers.renderer: mesh (ring/crown mesh) or sprites in ring pattern
emitter_layers.material_type: Translucent, water material with refraction, slight blue tint
emitter_layers.spawn: burst: 1 mesh or 8-15 sprites in ring
emitter_layers.size_over_life: expand ring outward, height rises then falls (parabolic)
emitter_layers.velocity: outward + upward initially, then gravity takes over

emitter_layers.name: Droplets
emitter_layers.notes: Size variety essential. Some large drops, many small. Velocity-aligned stretch for fast droplets.

emitter_layers.name: Mist_Spray
emitter_layers.notes: Adds atmosphere. Most visible in backlight/sunlight.

emitter_layers.name: Ripples
emitter_layers.purpose: Concentric expanding rings on water surface
emitter_layers.material_type: Translucent, normal map distortion, or opacity ring texture
emitter_layers.notes: Multiple rings at different delays creates concentric ripple effect

emitter_layers.name: Foam_Ring
emitter_layers.purpose: White foam circle at splash base

emitter_layers.name: Raindrops
emitter_layers.material_type: Additive or translucent, thin vertical line/streak
emitter_layers.spawn_location: Large box above camera, 2000-5000 cm wide, following player
emitter_layers.size: length 5-15 cm, width 0.5-1.5 cm (velocity stretch handles this)
emitter_layers.velocity: downward -800 to -1500 cm/s + slight horizontal for wind
emitter_layers.color: white-light blue, low opacity (0.1-0.3), slight emissive for visibility
emitter_layers.notes: Spawn above and behind camera frustum. Kill when below ground plane.

emitter_layers.name: Ground_Splashes
emitter_layers.purpose: Small splashes where rain hits ground
emitter_layers.material_type: Additive, small splash sprite or flipbook
emitter_layers.spawn_rate: proportional to raindrop rate, but spawn on ground plane
emitter_layers.spawn_location: Random positions on ground plane around player

emitter_layers.name: Mist_Layer
emitter_layers.notes: Only for heavy rain. Creates atmosphere.

emitter_layers.name: Water_Sheet
emitter_layers.material_type: Translucent, panning UV downward, water normal map, refraction
emitter_layers.spawn_location: Line or box along waterfall top edge
emitter_layers.velocity: forward (off edge) 50-150 cm/s + gravity pulls down
emitter_layers.notes: Ribbon renderer creates smooth sheet. Sprite approach needs many overlapping particles.

emitter_layers.name: Impact_Foam
emitter_layers.purpose: White churning foam where water hits pool
emitter_layers.material_type: Translucent or additive, white foam texture

water_refraction.normal_map: panning dual-layer normal for surface ripple
water_refraction.base_color: very slight blue-green tint, mostly transparent

caustics.description: Light patterns cast by water surface
caustics.technique: Dual-layer panning noise textures multiplied together → caustic pattern
caustics.application: Project onto surfaces below water as light cookie or decal

key_principles.gravity_drives_everything: Water is physical. All droplets, streams, waterfalls obey gravity. No floating water.
key_principles.transparency_and_refraction: Water is mostly transparent. Use refraction, not solid colored sprites.
key_principles.surface_tension: Small drops are round (surface tension). Large volumes are irregular. Size determines shape.
key_principles.foam_at_energy: Where water has high energy (impact, rapids) → white foam. Calm water → clear/transparent.
key_principles.mist_sells_scale: Mist/spray around waterfalls and large splashes sells the scale and energy.
key_principles.ripples_ground_the_effect: Ripples on water surface connect the 3D particles to the water plane.

niagara_modules_needed: Initialize Particle (or Initialize Ribbon for streams/waterfalls)
Add Velocity (outward for splash, downward for rain/waterfall)
Gravity Force (-980 cm/s² for all physical water)
Drag (minimal, 0.02-0.1 — water has low air resistance)
Collision (for ground splash detection in rain)
Scale Sprite Size (size over life curves)
